featured_reviews.review_text:
My Dell Inspiron 15 5510 had suddenly shut down, stopped charging, and even had a burning smell from the power section. I honestly thought the motherboard was damaged.

Luckily, I got in touch with 3NOT1 Technologies, and the repair was personally handled by Irfan bhai. He diagnosed the issue quickly and accurately, explained everything clearly, and fixed it properly — all at a very fair cost. He repaired the necessary components

Now my laptop is working perfectly — charging, running smoothly, and showing no issues at all. Irfan bhai’s approach was calm, confident, and highly skilled. It's rare to meet someone this honest and technically sound in the repair field.

If you're facing any laptop issues, I’d highly recommend reaching out to Irfan bhai at 3NOT1.

Thank you, Irfan bhai, for bringing my laptop back to life!

featured_reviews.name: Gerald John
featured_reviews.review_text: I've had 2 instances of an issue with my laptop. Both the times I received prompt and right action to my issues. On the first instance my adapter had ceased to work. Irfan the owner and technician tried to repair my adapter to save the cost but it needed replacement though Although the intent didn't go unnoticed. On the second instance the body of my laptop had a major crack. The laptop was applied with glue internally when I had given it to another technician for a hard disk change. He did a great job to ensure the glue was removed to change the body and it was done without any further damage . I find them reliable and would use their services in the future whenever needed. Thank you Irfan bhai.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words and trust! 😊 We’re glad we could help you both times and truly appreciate your continued support. Always here whenever you need us. 🙏 — Irfan & Team, 3not1 Technologies 💻⚙️

featured_reviews.name: Saif Kazi
featured_reviews.review_text: My PC suddenly made a popping sound and shut down completely. Irfan Bhai quickly identified the issue as a faulty power supply unit. Really impressed with his professionalism, honesty, and attention to detail. Highly recommended!
